placements.title: What should not win as a title
placements.frame: What criteria separate a title that should win from one that should not?
placements.why: The segment presents a title explicitly marked as one that should not win — a concrete instance of the judgment practice of title selection and naming decisions. The subject of what should or should not win as a title is one future envelopes in this repo will keep feeding, passing the grain test: it names a thematic practice, not a one-time fact.
